meta.name: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan
meta.description: Buy! Sell! Profit...or lose it all! University student Kurumi Fukuga jumps into the fast-moving world of foreign exchange trading to recover the 20 million yen her late mother lost. Together with fellow FX enthusiasts Mochiko, Mebuki, and Yasuko, she’ll battle volatile markets where every decision can lead to fortune—or disaster!

videos.title: What's Forex?
videos.overview: Kurumi enters the world of forex to prove she can succeed where her mother once failed.

videos.title: It's Okay, I've Got Leverage
videos.overview: After some advice from her friend Mochiko, Kurumi takes a risky position trading the Australian dollar.

videos.title: Do I Have to Cut My Losses…?
videos.overview: AUD/JPY takes Kurumi on a wild ride, and she finds herself at risk of losing all the money she "borrowed."

videos.title: Having No Unrealized Losses Is the Best
videos.overview: Kurumi has an awkward confrontation with her dad, and then gets roped into teaching forex to a new investor.

videos.title: Long? Short? Which Do I Choose?
videos.overview: Kurumi quits forex and tries hard to find a new hobby, but the temptation to start trading again is strong.

videos.title: Pay Attention to Economic Indicators!
videos.overview: Mebuki attempts to trade forex without Kurumi's help, but does she know enough about how the markets work?

videos.title: I Don't Wanna Have a Forced Liquidation...
videos.overview: The girls begin an investment competition, all while Mebuki clings tenaciously to her risky short position.

videos.title: Monetary Easing Is a Wild Party
videos.overview: After losing all her initial funds, Mebuki resorts to borrowing money to maintain a short position on USD/JPY.
